versions.content: Applications have to adhere to the following rules during multi block read requests for implicit synchronization between application and NVRAM man- ager: The BSW Mode Manager issues the NvM_ReadAll. 1. The BSW Mode Manager can use polling to get the status of the request or can be informed via a callback function. 2. During NvM_ReadAll, a single block callback (if configured) will be invoked after having completely processed a NVRAM block. These callbacks enable the RTE to start each SW-C individually.
